intro:
Memorize the scene in 60 seconds!
Recall the clues and crack the case
Feel like a master detective!
description:
Mysterious cases are unfolding on the streets of 18th-century London.
Study each crime-scene illustration for 60 seconds, then rely on your memory to solve the case in this observation and memory game.

Playing is easy!
・Study the crime-scene illustration for 60 seconds
・Memorize the people, belongings, and places as much as you can
・Answer each question using what you remember

“What was that person holding?”
“What was placed over there?”
“What’s different from the scene you just saw?”

The key to solving each case is hidden in the scene you already witnessed.

The setting is 18th-century London.
Take on mysterious cases set around street corners, homes, and other atmospheric locations while testing your observation skills and memory like a true detective.

Each round is quick and easy to enjoy in short bursts, making it a great brain-training pick for spare moments.
Focus on the challenge solo, or have fun with family and friends as you ask, “What was there?” and compare memories.

Recommended for players who like:
・Memory-testing games
・Brain training that uses observation and focus
・Detective stories and mystery atmospheres
・Quick quizzes that are easy to play anytime
・Solving questions together with family or friends

Can you memorize every clue needed to solve the case in just 60 seconds?
